snippet.title: CONTROL Resonant - Take CONTROL Trailer | PC Gaming Show June 2026
snippet.description:
Wield the Aberrant. Stop the Hiss. Rediscover your humanity. Take control.

After years of imprisonment at the hands of the Federal Bureau of Control, Dylan Faden is free on the streets of Manhattan. But the city is overrun by otherworldly forces and at the peak of a paranatural crisis, and Dylan needs to contain and comprehend the dangers he is now facing. His sister, Bureau Director Jesse Faden, is missing. He has to find her and reckon with the world around him.

CONTROL Resonant arrives September 24th 2026 to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, PC via Steam and Epic Games Store, and Mac via Steam and the App Store. Pre-order now!

PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10017682/ 
Xbox Series X|S: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9p092299fsgw
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3669870/CONTROL_Resonant/
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/control-resonant-3568d3

Developed and published by Remedy Entertainment. 

Find out more at https://controlgame.com/
